TestHandleRUMInflatesDeflatedBody/001.why: Recorded behind Go's rumEngine wrapper, which set the CORS headers before the Gin engine ran; the replay runs the route set without Rum.wrap. RumTests replays this fixture through the wrapper and compares these headers. RemoteAddr is the peer address, 192.0.2.1 in every Go httptest request; the fixture does not record it and the replay's HttpContext has no peer. RumTests replays this fixture with that peer and compares the column.
